basic_details.job_title: GMC Khammam Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 60 DEO, Lab Attendant and Other Posts
basic_details.short_information: Government Medical College (GMC), Khammam has announced 60 vacancies for Data Entry Operator, Lab Attendant, Office Subordinate, Nursing Officer, Attendant and other posts on an outsourcing basis. The application process starts on 23 October 2026 and closes on 31 October 2026 at 5 PM. Eligible local candidates must submit their applications offline.

application_fee.details: The GMC Khammam Recruitment 2026 notification does not specify an application fee. Candidates should check the official application instructions and any subsequent notices before submitting their forms.

content_sections.heading: GMC Khammam Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The application period for GMC Khammam Recruitment 2026 is from 23 October to 31 October 2026. Candidates must submit their applications in person by 5 PM on the closing date. The provisional merit list is scheduled for 11-15 November 2026, followed by the final merit list on 16 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: GMC Khammam Vacancy 2026 - Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Government Medical College Khammam has notified 60 vacancies across 17 post categories. Data Entry Operator has the highest number of vacancies with 20 posts, followed by Office Subordinate with 8 and Lab Attendant with 7 posts. Vacancies are assigned to District or Zone-IV appointment units as specified in the notification. content_sections.heading: GMC Khammam Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: GMC Khammam Recruitment 2026 has different educational and experience requirements for each post. Candidates with qualifications ranging from 7th or 10th standard to ITI, Diploma, Graduation, Nursing and Medical Laboratory Technology qualifications may be eligible for specific vacancies. Important: Applicants must possess the exact qualifications, experience, registration certificates and local eligibility required for their selected post. Candidates should refer to the official notification for complete conditions. For the 20 Data Entry Operator vacancies, candidates must possess a degree from a recognized university or institution, PGDCA or computer knowledge, and a typing/data entry speed of at least 8,000 key depressions per hour. The monthly remuneration is ₹19,500. For the 7 Lab Attendant vacancies, applicants must have B.Sc in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT) or DMLT from a recognized institution. Registration with the Telangana Para Medical Board is required. The monthly remuneration is ₹15,600. For the 8 Office Subordinate vacancies, candidates must have passed the 10th Class examination or an equivalent examination. The monthly remuneration is ₹15,600.

content_sections.heading: GMC Khammam Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age for GMC Khammam Recruitment 2026 is 18 years, and the maximum age is 44 years. The notification specifies 1 July 2024 for determining general age eligibility. Upper age relaxation is available to eligible reserved-category candidates. Note: The notification separately specifies 1 July 2026 for calculating age-weightage marks in selection. Candidates should not confuse this selection calculation date with the general age eligibility date.

content_sections.heading: GMC Khammam Salary 2026 - Post-wise Monthly Pay
content_sections.text: The monthly remuneration for GMC Khammam Recruitment 2026 ranges from ₹15,600 to ₹25,140, depending on the post. Nursing Officer carries the highest notified monthly remuneration of ₹25,140, while Data Entry Operator and several technical posts offer ₹19,500 per month. The notification specifies monthly remuneration of ₹15,600, ₹19,500 or ₹25,140 depending on the post. It does not separately provide take-home salary after deductions. Candidates should treat the notified remuneration as the stated payment amount, not a confirmed net in-hand salary.

content_sections.text: Selection for GMC Khammam Recruitment 2026 will be based on a merit system carrying 100 marks. Of these, 90 marks are assigned based on the qualifying examination, and 10 marks are assigned based on age. A provisional merit list will be published for objections before the final selection list is prepared. Age weightage is calculated from 18 years of age at 0.5 marks for each completed year, up to a maximum of 10 marks. For this purpose, age is reckoned as on 1 July 2026. 20 years of age: 1 mark 30 years of age: 6 marks 40 years of age: 10 marks The merit list will be prepared using the notified criteria, and the final selection list will follow the applicable reservation rules and Presidential Order 2018. The notification does not prescribe a separate written recruitment examination. Selection is based on qualifying examination marks and age weightage under the notified 100-mark merit system.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by GMC Khammam?
faq.answer: Government Medical College Khammam has announced a total of 60 vacancies for various outsourcing posts including Nursing Officer, Data Entry Operator, Lab Attendant, Office Subordinate, and others.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled-in offline application form in person at the Office of the Principal, Government Medical College, Khammam is 31 October 2026 up to 5 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required age limit for GMC Khammam Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 years and 44 years of age as on 01-07-2026. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based on 90 marks from the qualifying examination and 10 marks awarded for age, followed by a provisional merit list and final selection as per reservation rules.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for GMC Khammam jobs?
faq.answer: Candidates need to download the application form from the official website http://gmc.khammam.org, fill it out, attach self-attested documents, and submit it in person at the college office.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The Data Entry Operator post carries a monthly salary of Rs. 19,500/- under the outsourcing contract scheme.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only local cadre candidates possessing the requisite qualifications such as 7th class, 10th class, ITI, Diploma, Degree, B.Sc Nursing, GNM, DMLT, etc., are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for GMC Khammam recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official recruitment notification released by Government Medical College Khammam.

faq.question: Q9. What is the contract duration for these positions?
faq.answer: The posts are filled on an outsourcing basis for a period of one year or until further orders from the competent authority.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled application form be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in person at the Office of the Principal, Government Medical College, Khammam before the stipulated deadline.
